plugins.name: sonu
plugins.description: Prabhdeep (Sonu)'s personal Claude Code toolkit. Commands: /sonu:build — conductor that sequences triage, a standards-constrained design-tree gate in plan mode, a test-first build, and a risk hand-back (never commits); /sonu:ship — PR babysitter that branches, commits, opens the PR from the right per-change-type template, gathers Claude + every enabled AI reviewer bot (Copilot, CodeRabbit, Aikido, …), fixes/justifies/resolves every finding, loops until clean, then merges; /sonu:tdd — explicit red-green-refactor session; /sonu:design-tree — map a decision as a branching tree; /sonu:self-review — the 3–5 riskiest spots in the current diff. Auto-applied skills: code-standards (Sonu's coding foundation — naming, schema conventions, safe data access, logging, validation, leak prevention), tdd (test-first discipline), design-tree (decide by branching with recorded alternatives — standards load as pre-decided constraints, plans come out executor-ready), self-review (risk pointer, not a score), blast-radius (consumer impact before changing any contract — enumerate readers, catch silent degradation, verify one downstream path), debugging (the scientific find-the-cause loop — reproduce, one hypothesis at a time, revert dead ends), pr-conventions (per-change-type PR templates, living descriptions, reviewer-thread replies), safe-migrations (zero-downtime schema changes — expand → migrate → contract, reversible steps), infra-standards (IaC plan-before-apply, Dockerfile baselines, CI/CD and secrets discipline), observability (instrumentation, health checks, and alert quality worth paging on), seo-standards (technical SEO bar), and content-seo (editorial SEO + AI-citation formatting).
